name: POST /api/leadflow/sequences/inbound/poll - Consume inbound signals and stop what they should
description: Polls the inbound channels for replies, bounces and opt-outs, applies the stop rules to whatever it finds, and reports how many cadences it halted. 200 rather than 201: a command that consumes a stream and creates no addressable resource. WATERMARKED PER SOURCE, so a re-poll does not re-handle events it has already consumed - without that, a retry after a timeout would stop the same cadences twice and count each once more. A SOFT BOUNCE IS DELIBERATELY NOT A STOP: a full mailbox that clears next week should not end the relationship, and treating every delivery failure as a refusal would silently shrink the audience nobody chose to shrink. QA: depends on register and login for the bearer token; with no inbound connector configured it answers 200 with polled false and upstream_available reporting why, which is the honest degraded answer rather than a failure.

testCases.name: A poll reports what it consumed and what it stopped
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
